name: Agent Desktop & Real-Time Co-Pilot
description: Unified single-pane-of-glass agent workspace augmented with a real-time AI co-pilot that listens to live transcripts, surfaces next-best-response knowledge cards, enforces compliance checklists, and automates after-call work (ACW) summarization.
roleInCenter: Frontline cockpit and co-pilot: eliminates swivel-chair app switching, drafts grounded responses in real time, and automates wrap-up notes and dispositions so agents focus on the customer.

glossary.definition: Single-pane-of-glass interface consolidating omnichannel media controls, customer 360 context, knowledge assist, and core transaction forms
Generative LLM synthesis producing structured problem-action-resolution notes, extracted entities, and recommended wrap codes at interaction end
Contextual knowledge snippet or drafted reply pushed to the agent screen within seconds of a detected customer question or objection
Automated execution of wrap-up tasks including disposition tagging, CRM case field population, and follow-up email drafting
Composite UI widgets and background API orchestrations that replace manual copy-pasting across 5 to 15 legacy billing, order, and ticketing screens
Dynamic on-screen tracker that checks off mandatory disclosures and verification phrases as the agent speaks them during the live call
Concise visual card displayed on screen pop summarizing prior IVR or virtual agent turns, authentication status, and customer sentiment
Non-intrusive desktop indicator alerting the agent to slow speech rate, avoid interruption, or acknowledge frustration when customer stress rises

failureModes.name: Co-Pilot Card Spam & Cognitive Overload
failureModes.signal: Agents ignore or minimize the co-pilot panel because noisy, low-relevance cards pop up on every sentence
failureModes.mitigation: Gate card pops on high intent-shift confidence, cap active cards to two on screen, and suppress duplicates

failureModes.name: Unreviewed Auto-Summary Factual Drift
failureModes.signal: Incorrect dollar amounts or promised dates appear in CRM case notes because agents click save without reviewing the generated summary
failureModes.mitigation: Highlight extracted numbers and commitments in bold review chips requiring explicit agent confirmation before CRM write

failureModes.name: Late Knowledge Card Arrival
failureModes.signal: Co-pilot surfaces the correct policy card 15 seconds after the agent already placed the customer on hold to search manually
failureModes.mitigation: Stream partial ASR transcripts with sub-2-second semantic cache lookup on top 200 recurring intents

failureModes.name: Incomplete Screen-Pop Context Hydration
failureModes.signal: Agent answers call to a blank workspace or spinning loader, forcing manual account lookup and extending handle time
failureModes.mitigation: Pre-hydrate CRM profile and bot handoff brief during ACD ring state with cached fallback views

scoringModel.name: Co-Pilot Precision & Cognitive Load Reduction Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates unified agent workspace and AI co-pilot performance across real-time whisper relevance, swivel-chair cognitive load reduction, live compliance guidance, and ACW auto-summarization fidelity.

stateVariables.description: Continuous agent working-memory and cognitive load state driven by application context-switch frequency, customer emotional intensity, and unassisted knowledge search
Real-time semantic precision and utility score of surfaced co-pilot knowledge cards conditioned on the live conversation state and agent screen focus
Information-theoretic compression fidelity quantifying the fraction of decision-critical interaction facts and commitments preserved in the streaming ACW summary
Instantaneous post-contact wrap-up completion hazard rate governing how rapidly after-call work terminates once call audio ends
Instantaneous rate of window focus transitions and manual clipboard operations across disparate desktop applications

differentialEquations.name: Agent Cognitive Load & Context-Switch Damping ODE
differentialEquations.formula: dL_cog(t) * inv(dt) = -alpha_relax * (L_cog(t) - L_0) + beta_swivel * nu_switch(t) + beta_noise * I_spam_card(t) - gamma_assist * R_whisp(t) * I_card_used(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Models working-memory load L_cog(t) rising under swivel-chair switching nu_switch(t) and noisy low-relevance card pops I_spam_card(t), while high-precision adopted whisper cards R_whisp(t) actively offload memory retrieval and reduce cognitive strain

differentialEquations.name: Streaming Summarization Information-Bottleneck Fidelity Flow
differentialEquations.formula: dF_sum(t) * inv(dt) = kappa_ext * (1 - F_sum(t)) * I_salient(du_t; Y_crm) - delta_drift * max(0, L_transcript(t) - L_window)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Tracks how streaming entity and commitment extraction accumulates salient CRM mutual information I_salient(du_t; Y_crm) toward F_sum(t) -> 1 during the live call, eliminating end-of-call summarization wait time

differentialEquations.name: After-Contact Work (ACW) Wrap-Up Hazard Acceleration Law
differentialEquations.formula: h_acw(t) = h_base * exp( eta_sum * F_sum(t_end) + eta_disp * P_auto_disp(t_end) - zeta_cog * L_cog(t_end) )
differentialEquations.interpretation: Demonstrates that high streaming summary fidelity F_sum(t_end) and confident auto-disposition prediction P_auto_disp(t_end) at call disconnect exponentially accelerate wrap-up completion hazard h_acw(t), compressing ACW duration by 50% to 70%

scaleInvariants: Card-spam cognitive bound: gating whisper emission on R_whisp(t) >= theta_rel and active card count <= 2 guarantees net negative cognitive load contribution from the co-pilot
Pre-answer hydration invariant: 100% of prior CAI slots and CRM 360 context hydrate within the ACD ring window (< 400ms), driving initial swivel-chair rate nu_switch(0) -> 0
Zero-hallucination CRM commit invariant: mandatory entity-confirmation chips ensure 100% of numeric and date commitments in auto-summaries are verified prior to persistence
